name: AusBBS
summary: NBN-focused ISP (Australian Broadband Services Pty Limited), founded April 2012 by Rob Appel (ex-OzEmail); cited as the first purely cloud-based ISP and the first to offer unlimited NBN plans; acquired by Amaysim July 2016 for $4m.

events.details: Founded April 2012 by Rob Appel (ex-OzEmail; founder of Chaos.com); first purely cloud-based ISP and first to offer unlimited NBN plans (May 2013); signed as first reseller of the LBNCo/Service Elements FTTP networks (Aug 2013); first to launch TPG FTTB (Mar 2015).
Acquired by Amaysim for $4 million (announced 19 Jul 2016); gave Amaysim its broadband business and AAPT wholesale relationship.
